boundaries.scope: Handwritten models are not source/bytecode/VM refinement. Exact runtime tests and source/artifact provenance are separately required.
Domain and witness predicates are modeled; crypto verification and arbitrary plugins remain external assumptions.
Finite topology and lifecycle models do not establish arbitrary-plugin behavior or operational liveness.
Abstract account/epoch tuple separation assumes no future-generation writes. Concrete 0xA2 key encoding, exact native epoch reads and complete module use require source review and VM tests.
Bounded callback charge models do not prove complete fee estimation, mempool policy, max-roster cost or resource liveness.
